inputs.prompt: A single continuous photorealistic landscape shot from a perfectly stationary mountaintop camera. Preserve the supplied photograph's composition, forested mountain silhouettes, horizon, pale sky and soft natural lighting throughout. A vast sea of moist clouds fills the valleys below the viewpoint. The cloud sea moves very slowly and coherently from left to right: broad layers drift, gently rise and curl over one another; delicate translucent wisps stretch and evaporate along the edges; thin fog softly spills around the immovable ridges. The vapor is loose, airy and smoky, with subtle natural internal motion rather than isolated cotton balls. Quiet, unhurried movement for a relaxing desktop wallpaper, normal real-world speed, not accelerated time-lapse. Both keyframes depict the same landscape; smoothly return toward the original cloud arrangement near the end while maintaining continuous motion. Keep exposure and illumination stable, without a sunrise or sunset occurring inside the clip. Locked-off camera: no pan, tilt, zoom, dolly, shake, cut, scene change or focus pull. Mountains and trees never move, wobble, morph, grow or dissolve. No rapid boiling, pulsing, violent storm, flashing, flickering, grain, rain, birds, people, buildings appearing, text, logos or watermarks. Audio: silent, no music, no voice, no effects.
